errors.evidence: The description compares the performance of one model group to the other two, which violates the prompt's instruction to avoid comparisons between categories.

errors.text_span: 所有柱状图均标注具体数值于柱顶
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the data labels are on top of the bars ('柱顶'). The figure shows the numerical values are inside the bars, near the bottom.

errors.text_span: 从左至右，各组模型的性能呈现递增趋势，其中“本文模型”在所有三项指标上均取得最高分，且其三根柱子高度接近，表明模型在准确率与召回率之间取得较好平衡。
errors.evidence: This sentence provides analysis and interpretation rather than objective description. It identifies a trend across categories ('递增趋势'), identifies the best-performing category ('取得最高分'), and draws a conclusion about model balance ('取得较好平衡'), all of which are forbidden by the prompt.
